memory_update.text: AVPT should remain in the underfollowed AI software/data-readiness lane because its governance, access-control, auditability, and resilience products map directly to enterprise AI deployment prerequisites.
ALKT is a vertical regulated-workflow AI hypothesis: its financial-institution software and AI/data products may benefit from AI adoption without being labeled as an AI infrastructure company.
BBAI belongs in speculative_shadow rather than core underfollowed due to stronger narrative risk, government-contract lumpiness, and need to verify revenue quality and cash conversion.

For AI software, the bottleneck screen should prioritize data governance, regulated deployment, workflow integration, observability/security, auditability, and independent revenue quality over generic AI marketing language.

Later layers should explicitly test whether AI-related software revenue is separately disclosed, whether customers are independent, and whether net retention/gross margin/free cash flow support claims of AI-driven adoption.
